OBJECT.TITLE: Purpose and Scope of Application
OBJECT.PARAGRAPH1: These regulations aim to establish the rules, conditions, and procedures applicable to the electronic auction of coffee lots with cup scores above 85, selected as winners in the Regional Tournament for Coffee Families.
OBJECT.PARAGRAPH2: These regulations govern the rights, obligations, and sanctions for all participants, and establish the provisions that regulate the organization, development, and formalization of lot awards, in order to ensure the transparency, fairness, and legality of the auction process.

PARTICIPATION.TITLE: Participation
PARTICIPATION.ELIGIBILITY_DESC: The auction is open to individuals and legal entities who complete their registration and pass a reliability assessment conducted by the organizer, which verifies compliance history and payment capacity. To fully participate in the auction, you must register at least 15 minutes before the auction closes. The organization reserves the right to reject participants who do not meet the established reliability standards.
PARTICIPATION.RESPONSIBILITY_DESC: Participation in the auction implies express acceptance of the provisions contained in these regulations, as well as the commitment to comply with all rules and instructions from the organizer.

DURATION.TITLE: Auction Duration
DURATION.START_DESC: The auction will begin according to the date and time established for each event.
DURATION.END_DESC: The auction will end according to the scheduled date and time for each event.
DURATION.FOOTNOTE: The established schedule will be non-negotiable, except in extraordinary circumstances, in which case participants will be notified in advance.

BIDDING.TITLE: Bidding Procedure
BIDDING.MECHANISM_POINT1: Bids will be made exclusively through the auction platform.
BIDDING.MECHANISM_POINT2: Each lot will have a starting price. Bids must be made in minimum increments, which will be specified for each lot.
BIDDING.NOTE_DESC: All amounts are expressed in US dollars (USD). For conversion to Bolivianos, use the official exchange rate of 1 USD = 6.97 Bs.
BIDDING.AWARD_CONDITION1: The lot will be awarded to the participant who has registered the highest bid at the close of the auction.
BIDDING.AWARD_CONDITION2: In case of a tie between two or more bids, the award will correspond to the first winning bid entered.

CONFIRMATION.TITLE: Award Confirmation and Purchase Formalization
CONFIRMATION.NOTIFICATION_DESC: Winners will be notified by email once the auction has ended, indicating the details of the awarded lot and payment instructions.
CONFIRMATION.PAYMENT_DEADLINE_DESC: Winners have a period of 24 hours, counted from notification, to formalize the acquisition by signing the award document and making a 30% advance payment of the total value.
CONFIRMATION.NON_COMPLIANCE_DESC: In case an awardee does not make the payment within the established period:
CONFIRMATION.NON_COMPLIANCE_POINT1: The lot will be offered to the next highest bidder.
CONFIRMATION.NON_COMPLIANCE_POINT2: A sanction of definitive exclusion of the awardee from future auctions will be applied.

PAYMENT_SHIPPING.TITLE: Payment and Shipping Conditions
PAYMENT_SHIPPING.PAYMENT_METHODS_DESC: Payment must be made exclusively through the means authorized by the organizer, notified prior to award.
PAYMENT_SHIPPING.SHIPPING_CONDITIONS_DESC: Shipping costs will be assumed by the buyer, who will receive the estimated delivery time once payment is confirmed.

CANCELLATION.TITLE: Cancellation and Refund Policies
CANCELLATION.CANCELLATION_DESC: If payment is not made within the stipulated period, the awardee will lose the right to the lot, which will be offered to the next bidder.
CANCELLATION.REFUNDS_DESC: Refunds of awarded lots will not be accepted, except in cases where the organizer fails to comply with the conditions established in these regulations.

GENERAL.TITLE: General Provisions
GENERAL.MODIFICATION_DESC: The organizer reserves the right to modify these regulations, committing to inform registered participants of any changes.
GENERAL.ACCEPTANCE_DESC: Participation in the auction constitutes full acceptance of the provisions contained in these regulations.
GENERAL.CONTACT_INFO_DESC: For additional inquiries, participants can communicate through the email enabled on the auction platform.
